Sorted Rasterization of Projected Tetrahedra — GPU DVR for unstructured data via sorted PT, Tet-by-Tet Ray Casting
definition: An interactive volume rendering method for scalar data on unstructured tetrahedral grids, using CUDA for parallel projection and sorting, and OpenGL/GLSL for rasterization and compositing.
summary: Sorted Rasterization of Projected Tetrahedra is an interactive volume rendering method that projects tetrahedra directly into screen-space triangles and sorts them using a dedicated CUDA kernel with the Thrust library.
